'''Jor "Oneshot" Mesok''' was a renowned [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] living during the aftermath of the [[War against Zakuul]]. They were a member of the [[Crimson Fang]] gang, which following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]] took over [[Port Nowhere]] by force, planning to use the mobile space station as their base of operations. The Alliance sent a strike team on a mission to liberate Port Nowhere, who systematically rid the station of Outer Rim's most notorious villains, confronting Mesok and killing them.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jor "Oneshot" Mesok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising.<ref name="SWTOR" />
